title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 3�<6 hrs | AC Wallet (20%) | Multi Pax
description:
Validates an eligible flight disruption scenario for a single passenger on a single domestic AC leg delayed 4 hours due to a controllable reason (Code 67), where the customer selects AC Wallet instead of Cash. Validates that when the customer has an active Aeroplan account (Elite 50K) linked and in good standing, the AC Wallet option is offered with a 20% top-up ($480 total). Confirms DDS correctly identifies the APPR regime, controllable classification, and Tier 1 delay band. Confirms EAP (E-credit Application Platform) check passes, CyberSource returns GREEN for auto-approval, and $480 CAD is deposited to the Aeroplan profile.


Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Marie-Claire Dubois), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 14:00, Actual arrival 18:00 (4hr delay). Arrival delay code: 67(Crew) on arrival. Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+13). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan: Linked to booking (Elite 50K), account in good standing (NOT frozen). CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN.
